_: vLLM 0.30 (an axis named null is not named: the embedding's width is the residual stream, which the rule's per-call names (a matmul contracts "hidden" and makes "feature") do not name across layers): what vLLM itself declares about the values it makes, as the rule names it (read by entail/adapters/vllm_declarations.py). layers: a layer kind (a class in the module's MRO) -> the names of a weight's output axis (output_dim) and input axis (input_dim); the MoE layer's weights are [expert, out, in] (in, out when the parameter says is_transposed). scales: a value parameter -> the parameters that are its scales; a scale's axes follow the value's by broadcast (equal size: the same axis; a size that divides: groups; size 1: no coordinate). functions: module:function (module:Class.method) -> what its tensor arguments mean (args: name -> [axes, basis], or "moe_weight"), which arguments pair as value and scale (pairs), and what it returns (returns: per returned tensor [axes, basis], {"like": arg} for the argument's meaning, {"scale_of": index} for the scale of a returned value). relations and merges: how bases derive from one another, and what a flat index over two adjacent axes means. mutable: the parameters vLLM updates in place after loading (everything else a layer holds after loading is a constant: written by nothing again).
